qa_pairs.question: What are the torque values for M10 and M12 screws on the full flow oil filter?
How should the oil filter one-way cartridge (1AZ) be tightened?
qa_pairs.answer: Tightening torque by hand in accordance with specification on spin-on oil filter

qa_pairs.question: Which components are covered under section 11 42 Oil Filter and Pipes?
qa_pairs.answer: Oil filter (one-way cartridge), full flow oil filter (cover), and oil filter housing and lines on crankcase

qa_pairs.question: Do all the torque specifications in this section apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all specifications are marked as applying to 'All' vehicle types

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection does this oil filter and pipes torque specification belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 11-27 Engine, subsection 11 42 Oil Filter and Pipes
